title: LFM2.5-DSpark：推理速度提升高达3.2倍
summary: 本文介绍了Liquid AI推出的LFM2.5-DSpark模型，该模型在推理性能上实现了显著突破，相比基准模型推理速度提升最高达3.2倍。LFM2.5-DSpark基于LFM2.5架构，通过优化稀疏注意力机制和内核级计算，在保持模型质量的同时大幅降低延迟。文章详细阐述了其技术原理，包括动态稀疏模式、硬件感知的算子融合以及针对长序列场景的优化策略。实验结果表明，在多种硬件（如NVIDIA H100）和不同序列长度下，LFM2.5-DSpark均展现出稳定的加速效果，尤其适用于实时交互和长上下文任务。该模型已在Hugging Face平台开源，提供了API和本地部署选项，方便开发者集成。文章还讨论了与现有推理框架的兼容性，并给出了性能对比数据和实际应用案例。总体而言，LFM2.5-DSpark代表了高效推理技术的前沿进展，为大规模语言模型在资源受限环境中的部署提供了可行方案。
summary_en: This article introduces LFM2.5-DSpark by Liquid AI, which achieves up to 3.2x faster inference compared to baseline models. Built on the LFM2.5 architecture, it optimizes sparse attention and kernel-level computation to reduce latency while maintaining model quality. The technical details include dynamic sparsity patterns, hardware-aware operator fusion, and optimizations for long sequences. Experiments on hardware like NVIDIA H100 show consistent speedups across various sequence lengths, making it suitable for real-time and long-context tasks. The model is open-sourced on Hugging Face with API and local deployment options. The article also covers compatibility with existing frameworks, performance benchmarks, and use cases, highlighting its potential for efficient deployment of large language models in resource-constrained environments.
